t1.text: Banking — built on your own money-modules design

base.text:
BUILT ON YOUR 09-12 MONEY MODULES PREVIEW, NOT OVER IT

Your file already made the calls, and they hold:

10 tabs down to 8. Statement Import, Plaid Connections and + Create Account were duplicated as header links — they are now one + New menu.

The Factoring tab is gone. It is a whole module; a summary card deep-links to it.

The alert-banner pattern with an action button — Map Cash GL, Connect QBO — is yours. I kept it and pointed it at today's live numbers.

The sparkline, the 27px KPI figure, the 12.5px body, the navy/amber/red palette: all yours. Nothing was restyled for its own sake.

rules.text:
THE HOUSE RULES, APPLIED HERE

Lines for ROWS, never for columns. No cell declares a left or right border.

One control height — 34px for every filter, select and search; 40px for a field being edited.

Date box 132px wide everywhere, tabular figures. Money box 120px, right-aligned.

Missing renders — , never 0, and never -$0.00.

KPIs are tiles across, never bars down.

Gear icon on every table opens the column chooser.

Unit and account filters are multi-select chips plus a dropdown, with a type selector beside them.

Anything that opens carries Save and Close, both wired.
